<div id="react_0HNQCN74CS1A6"></div><script>
    (function (triggerType, cssSelector, experimentId) {
        let cache = null;

        const urlParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
        const suppressInterrupter = urlParams.has('suppressInterrupter');
        const collapseInterrupter = urlParams.has('collapseInterrupter');

        const getCookieValue = (name) =>
            document.cookie.split('; ').find(row => row.startsWith(name + '='))?.split('=')[1];

        const setCookie = (name, value) => {
            document.cookie = `${name}=${value}; path=/;`;
        };

        const migrateLocalStorageCookies = () => {
            const movedToBannerLocal = localStorage?.getItem('EmailSmsMovedToBanner');
            if (movedToBannerLocal) {
                setCookie('EmailSmsMovedToBanner', movedToBannerLocal);
            }
            localStorage.removeItem('EmailSmsMovedToBanner');
        };

        const buildInterrupterAsync = async () => {
            if (cache === null) {
                try {
                    const isKids = window.digitalData.page.attributes.navState.toLowerCase() === "cratekids";
                    const response = await fetch(
                        `/api/interrupter/build?experimentId=${experimentId}&isKids=${isKids}`,
                        { credentials: 'same-origin' }
                    );

                    if (response.status !== 200) {
                        sessionStorage?.setItem('noInterrupterData', "true");
                    } else {
                        sessionStorage?.removeItem('noInterrupterData');
                    }

                    cache = await response.json();
                    sessionStorage.setItem('interrupterData', JSON.stringify(cache));
                } catch (e) {
                    console.error('[Interrupter] buildInterrupterAsync error:', e);
                }
            }
            return cache;
        };

        const dispatchBannerEvent = (model) => {
            setTimeout(() => document.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('build-interrupter-banner', { detail: model })));
        };

        const dispatchModalEvent = (model) => {
            setTimeout(() => document.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('build-interrupter', { detail: model })));
        };

        const handleOnClick = async () => {
            const model = await buildInterrupterAsync();
            if (!model) return;
            dispatchModalEvent(model);
        };

        const handleInterrupterInitialized = async () => {
            if (suppressInterrupter) return;   

            migrateLocalStorageCookies();

            const model = await buildInterrupterAsync();
            if (!model) return;

            if (collapseInterrupter) {
                dispatchBannerEvent(model);
                return;
            }

            if (model.interrupterFrequencyLogicEnabled) {
                const tracker = window.getTabTracker();
                tracker.evaluateNewSession();
                const { isNewSession } = tracker.getState();

                if (isNewSession) {
                    if (model.isMobile) {
                        dispatchBannerEvent(model);
                    } else {
                        dispatchModalEvent(model);
                    }
                    return;
                }
            }

            const alreadyViewed = getCookieValue('EmailOptInAlreadyViewedCount');
            const movedToBanner = getCookieValue('EmailSmsMovedToBanner');

            if (alreadyViewed) return;

            if (movedToBanner || model.isMobile) {
                dispatchBannerEvent(model);
                return;
            }

            dispatchModalEvent(model);
        };

        const setupAutoTrigger = () => {
            document.addEventListener('InterrupterInitialized', handleInterrupterInitialized, { once: true });
        };

        const setupEventTrigger = () => {
            document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
                const triggerElement = document.querySelector(cssSelector);
                if (!triggerElement) {
                    throw new Error(`Interrupter trigger element with CSS selector: "${cssSelector}" not found...`);
                }

                triggerElement.addEventListener('click', () => handleOnClick());

                const bannerContainer = document.querySelector('.interrupter-banner-container');
                if (bannerContainer) {
                    bannerContainer.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
                        if (
                            event.target.classList.contains('mobile-collapsed-banner-button') ||
                            event.target.classList.contains('medium-banner-button')
                        ) {
                            handleOnClick();
                        }
                    });
                }
            });
        };

        switch (triggerType) {
            default:
                setupEventTrigger();
                break;
            case 'autotrigger':
                setupAutoTrigger();
                break;
        }
    })('autotrigger', '', '');
</script>

<div id="react_0HNQCN74CS1A6"></div><script>
    (function (triggerType, cssSelector, experimentId) {
        let cache = null;

        const urlParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
        const suppressInterrupter = urlParams.has('suppressInterrupter');
        const collapseInterrupter = urlParams.has('collapseInterrupter');

        const getCookieValue = (name) =>
            document.cookie.split('; ').find(row => row.startsWith(name + '='))?.split('=')[1];

        const setCookie = (name, value) => {
            document.cookie = `${name}=${value}; path=/;`;
        };

        const migrateLocalStorageCookies = () => {
            const movedToBannerLocal = localStorage?.getItem('EmailSmsMovedToBanner');
            if (movedToBannerLocal) {
                setCookie('EmailSmsMovedToBanner', movedToBannerLocal);
            }
            localStorage.removeItem('EmailSmsMovedToBanner');
        };

        const buildInterrupterAsync = async () => {
            if (cache === null) {
                try {
                    const isKids = window.digitalData.page.attributes.navState.toLowerCase() === "cratekids";
                    const response = await fetch(
                        `/api/interrupter/build?experimentId=${experimentId}&isKids=${isKids}`,
                        { credentials: 'same-origin' }
                    );

                    if (response.status !== 200) {
                        sessionStorage?.setItem('noInterrupterData', "true");
                    } else {
                        sessionStorage?.removeItem('noInterrupterData');
                    }

                    cache = await response.json();
                    sessionStorage.setItem('interrupterData', JSON.stringify(cache));
                } catch (e) {
                    console.error('[Interrupter] buildInterrupterAsync error:', e);
                }
            }
            return cache;
        };

        const dispatchBannerEvent = (model) => {
            setTimeout(() => document.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('build-interrupter-banner', { detail: model })));
        };

        const dispatchModalEvent = (model) => {
            setTimeout(() => document.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('build-interrupter', { detail: model })));
        };

        const handleOnClick = async () => {
            const model = await buildInterrupterAsync();
            if (!model) return;
            dispatchModalEvent(model);
        };

        const handleInterrupterInitialized = async () => {
            if (suppressInterrupter) return;   

            migrateLocalStorageCookies();

            const model = await buildInterrupterAsync();
            if (!model) return;

            if (collapseInterrupter) {
                dispatchBannerEvent(model);
                return;
            }

            if (model.interrupterFrequencyLogicEnabled) {
                const tracker = window.getTabTracker();
                tracker.evaluateNewSession();
                const { isNewSession } = tracker.getState();

                if (isNewSession) {
                    if (model.isMobile) {
                        dispatchBannerEvent(model);
                    } else {
                        dispatchModalEvent(model);
                    }
                    return;
                }
            }

            const alreadyViewed = getCookieValue('EmailOptInAlreadyViewedCount');
            const movedToBanner = getCookieValue('EmailSmsMovedToBanner');

            if (alreadyViewed) return;

            if (movedToBanner || model.isMobile) {
                dispatchBannerEvent(model);
                return;
            }

            dispatchModalEvent(model);
        };

        const setupAutoTrigger = () => {
            document.addEventListener('InterrupterInitialized', handleInterrupterInitialized, { once: true });
        };

        const setupEventTrigger = () => {
            document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
                const triggerElement = document.querySelector(cssSelector);
                if (!triggerElement) {
                    throw new Error(`Interrupter trigger element with CSS selector: "${cssSelector}" not found...`);
                }

                triggerElement.addEventListener('click', () => handleOnClick());

                const bannerContainer = document.querySelector('.interrupter-banner-container');
                if (bannerContainer) {
                    bannerContainer.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
                        if (
                            event.target.classList.contains('mobile-collapsed-banner-button') ||
                            event.target.classList.contains('medium-banner-button')
                        ) {
                            handleOnClick();
                        }
                    });
                }
            });
        };

        switch (triggerType) {
            default:
                setupEventTrigger();
                break;
            case 'autotrigger':
                setupAutoTrigger();
                break;
        }
    })('autotrigger', '', '');
</script>

<div id="react_0HNQCN74CS1A6"></div><script>
    (function (triggerType, cssSelector, experimentId) {
        let cache = null;

        const urlParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
        const suppressInterrupter = urlParams.has('suppressInterrupter');
        const collapseInterrupter = urlParams.has('collapseInterrupter');

        const getCookieValue = (name) =>
            document.cookie.split('; ').find(row => row.startsWith(name + '='))?.split('=')[1];

        const setCookie = (name, value) => {
            document.cookie = `${name}=${value}; path=/;`;
        };

        const migrateLocalStorageCookies = () => {
            const movedToBannerLocal = localStorage?.getItem('EmailSmsMovedToBanner');
            if (movedToBannerLocal) {
                setCookie('EmailSmsMovedToBanner', movedToBannerLocal);
            }
            localStorage.removeItem('EmailSmsMovedToBanner');
        };

        const buildInterrupterAsync = async () => {
            if (cache === null) {
                try {
                    const isKids = window.digitalData.page.attributes.navState.toLowerCase() === "cratekids";
                    const response = await fetch(
                        `/api/interrupter/build?experimentId=${experimentId}&isKids=${isKids}`,
                        { credentials: 'same-origin' }
                    );

                    if (response.status !== 200) {
                        sessionStorage?.setItem('noInterrupterData', "true");
                    } else {
                        sessionStorage?.removeItem('noInterrupterData');
                    }

                    cache = await response.json();
                    sessionStorage.setItem('interrupterData', JSON.stringify(cache));
                } catch (e) {
                    console.error('[Interrupter] buildInterrupterAsync error:', e);
                }
            }
            return cache;
        };

        const dispatchBannerEvent = (model) => {
            setTimeout(() => document.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('build-interrupter-banner', { detail: model })));
        };

        const dispatchModalEvent = (model) => {
            setTimeout(() => document.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('build-interrupter', { detail: model })));
        };

        const handleOnClick = async () => {
            const model = await buildInterrupterAsync();
            if (!model) return;
            dispatchModalEvent(model);
        };

        const handleInterrupterInitialized = async () => {
            if (suppressInterrupter) return;   

            migrateLocalStorageCookies();

            const model = await buildInterrupterAsync();
            if (!model) return;

            if (collapseInterrupter) {
                dispatchBannerEvent(model);
                return;
            }

            if (model.interrupterFrequencyLogicEnabled) {
                const tracker = window.getTabTracker();
                tracker.evaluateNewSession();
                const { isNewSession } = tracker.getState();

                if (isNewSession) {
                    if (model.isMobile) {
                        dispatchBannerEvent(model);
                    } else {
                        dispatchModalEvent(model);
                    }
                    return;
                }
            }

            const alreadyViewed = getCookieValue('EmailOptInAlreadyViewedCount');
            const movedToBanner = getCookieValue('EmailSmsMovedToBanner');

            if (alreadyViewed) return;

            if (movedToBanner || model.isMobile) {
                dispatchBannerEvent(model);
                return;
            }

            dispatchModalEvent(model);
        };

        const setupAutoTrigger = () => {
            document.addEventListener('InterrupterInitialized', handleInterrupterInitialized, { once: true });
        };

        const setupEventTrigger = () => {
            document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
                const triggerElement = document.querySelector(cssSelector);
                if (!triggerElement) {
                    throw new Error(`Interrupter trigger element with CSS selector: "${cssSelector}" not found...`);
                }

                triggerElement.addEventListener('click', () => handleOnClick());

                const bannerContainer = document.querySelector('.interrupter-banner-container');
                if (bannerContainer) {
                    bannerContainer.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
                        if (
                            event.target.classList.contains('mobile-collapsed-banner-button') ||
                            event.target.classList.contains('medium-banner-button')
                        ) {
                            handleOnClick();
                        }
                    });
                }
            });
        };

        switch (triggerType) {
            default:
                setupEventTrigger();
                break;
            case 'autotrigger':
                setupAutoTrigger();
                break;
        }
    })('autotrigger', '', '');
</script>
